name: earshot
description: Ears for coding agents: let AI hear, review and make sound. CPU-only, open source.
readme: Watch the 0.4 launch film (35 s): its sound effects are takes from the earshot bank placed with the launch kit, plus the one CC0 recording it shows being re-made, over a licensed music track. Play every sound in the bank on the earshot site. AI coding agents can now write the code that renders a film, a product demo or a game. They still cannot hear what they made. They cannot tell a premium key press from a cheap one, notice that a hit lands 80 ms after the cut, or hear that the music swells in the wrong place.
